email_subject: Application - Adoption Manager Digital Transformation & Change Management
email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Adoption Manager role at Pauwels Consulting. With a background in digital marketing, web development, and AI-driven automation, I've spent the last few years helping organisations adopt digital tools and optimise their online presence. At Knowledge Experts (KXP), I supported the build of SharePoint-based digital workplace sites for ŞOK Market (4,000+ stores) and Aras Kargo (12,000 staff), which gave me hands-on experience with large-scale rollouts and the challenges of driving adoption across distributed networks.

I'm comfortable facilitating workshops and creating practical training material, and I regularly translate complex technical information into simple, actionable content for clients. My work with analytics tools like Google Analytics and Search Console has taught me to track adoption metrics and turn data into improvement actions. I'm fluent in English and have a B1 level in Dutch (writing), with A2+ speaking, and I'm eager to strengthen my Dutch further in a professional context.

I'd welcome the chance to discuss how my experience can support your digital transformation initiatives.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm excited to apply for the Adoption Manager – Digital Transformation & Change Management position at Pauwels Consulting. My career has been built at the intersection of digital marketing, web development, and AI-driven automation, where I've consistently focused on helping people and organisations adopt new digital tools and ways of working.

At Knowledge Experts (KXP), I supported the team in building SharePoint-based digital workplace sites for major retail and logistics clients, including ŞOK Market (4,000+ stores) and Aras Kargo (12,000 staff). This experience gave me a practical understanding of large-scale rollouts and the importance of adoption strategies that work operationally. I saw firsthand how critical it is to engage product and project teams early, ensure solutions are field-ready, and provide clear, actionable material for end users.

I'm comfortable facilitating workshops and train-the-trainer sessions, and I regularly create practical guides and training content for clients. My work with analytics tools such as Google Analytics and Search Console has honed my ability to track adoption metrics and translate data into improvement actions. I also bring strong stakeholder management skills, a critical mindset, and a proactive approach to translating complex product information into simple, field-friendly material.

I'm fluent in English and have a B1 level in Dutch (writing) with A2+ speaking, and I'm keen to further develop my Dutch in a professional environment. While I haven't worked with structured change methodologies like ADKAR, I'm a fast learner and eager to apply my roll-out capabilities to drive successful adoption.

I'd love the opportunity to discuss how my experience can contribute to your digital transformation programmes.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
